evals.name: file-new-papers-and-tags
evals.prompt: 我的 Zotero 库在 /tmp/zl-fix/test_zotero.sqlite（Zotero 已关闭）。我最近加的几篇论文只丢在顶层大类里没细分，标签也乱七八糟——有中文的、有小写的。帮我看一下，生成一个 js 脚本把它们归到对应的子文件夹，标签也统一成英文的。
evals.expected_output: A .js file for Zotero Run JavaScript that adds items to correct subcollections and normalizes tags to English Title Case. Idempotent; must not modify the sqlite file.

evals.name: fix-metadata-consistency
evals.prompt: 帮我把 /tmp/zl-fix/test_zotero.sqlite 这个 Zotero 库的元数据规范一下：作者名有全大写的，有的中文作者名后面粘了邮箱，期刊名 Journal of Finance 和 The Journal of Finance 混着用，标题大小写也不统一。生成一个修复脚本。
evals.expected_output: A .js file fixing ALL-CAPS authors, stripping email from Chinese author name without deleting the name, unifying journal names to official titles, and Title-Casing titles including china -> China.

evals.name: repair-broken-nber-import
evals.prompt: 我往 Zotero 里拖了个 NBER 的 PDF，条目全乱了——标题变成了 "Nber working paper series"，什么都没有。库在 /tmp/zl-fix/test_zotero.sqlite。帮我修好这条，顺便归个类打上标签。
evals.expected_output: Identifies item AAAA0005 (Borri & Liu, AI consumption tokens), searches for the real paper, generates a .js setting title/type/repository/number/DOI/url plus collections and tags. Must not invent an unverified DOI.
